text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important part of NLP is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in written words. NLP also makes translation possible, so tools can quickly change text from one language into another. Another useful feature is sentiment analysis, which helps computers recognise whether a message is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, NLP powers chatbots, the virtual assistants that answer our questions online. Thanks to NLP, computers can communicate with us in a more natural and helpful way every day.
